items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: The next catalyst is close. Albemarle reports third-quarter results on Nov. 4. Commentary on storage demand and pricing could decide whether the chart finally turns. Of the 26 analysts covering the stock, 16 rate it a Buy or Strong Buy.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Battery storage is building a second floor of demand, and Western reshoring gives established domestic producers like Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) outsized leverage. Benchmark says demand from stationary storage has grown more than 60% a year over the past two years.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Albemarle faces persistent headwinds from weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, and rising supply-chain costs. Zacks view: Underperform.

items.headline: Albemarle investment rating upgraded on lithium demand outlook
items.snippet: Albemarle is seeing its stock price rise slightly as its investment rating is upgraded following analysis that lithium demand is stronger than expected.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory; ALB is the lowest-cost lithium producer.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating.
